subject: [PATCH v3 4/5] fs/proc/task_mmu: don't read young/dirty from a non-present PMD in smaps

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Linux kernel's /proc/PID/smaps functionality where it incorrectly reads young and dirty bits from PMDs that are not present. This occurs because pmd_young() and pmd_dirty() functions return garbage values for non-present entries, leading to incorrect accounting of memory usage. The patch addresses this issue by only reading the young and dirty bits when the PMD is actually present.
